title: Stats widget and multiple indices

comments.body: Never mind guys. I was looking at the documentation for version 2.
I am also stuck like this while getting the `stats` from multiple indices.  How did you get the `stats` of multiple indices?
you can either use a custom connector to read `scopedResults` or as a workaround with connectAutocomplete. We are aware of this issue, but haven't yet found a good solution @sachyya
